row.evidence: Smokeball's SSO guide has firms add Smokeball to Microsoft Entra as a non-gallery SAML app and send the claims to Support; no SCIM endpoint is documented on the pricing page, help centre or API reference, where users are managed in Staff & Users or via the /staff API.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only pricing: four plans (Bill, Boost, Grow, Prosper+), every plan shows 'Get pricing' and price depends on users, plan and contract term, so team_plan and prices are null. No SCIM: help-centre search for 'scim' returns 0 articles; docs.smokeball.com llms.txt lists no SCIM pages. SSO is SAML via a Microsoft Entra non-gallery app set up through a Support ticket; the SSO article names no plan, so sso_plan is null. The REST API (OAuth 2.0) has /staff, /firmusers, /invitations, /users and /groups endpoints; firms can build their own apps with direct production access, but no plan gate is stated. Deleting staff via API marks them former staff and disables access. Status none by absence (rule 5).

rate_limits.text: Token bucket; default 5 requests/second, burst 5, per region (US, AU, UK); 429 on excess.

fallbacks.notes: Users are added manually in Settings > Staff & Users or via the REST API.
